title: Apply the ascent hold before the model-specific counts prepass
trigger: Run nonconditional W1-T2 CHAIN100 with a counts row and no recorded CHAIN10 predecessor (likewise W1-T3 with no eligible previous size).
observed: run_tier starts bind_w1_launch_counts before admission checks previous_size at525–530; a counts-only child performs model/count work then the row is recorded not_run with an ascent-deferred reason.
impact: The new prepass executes model-specific work that the existing nonnumeric ascent hold was meant to defer. Its RSS/heap/timeout caps do not satisfy the missing ordering permission.
evidence: REPRO_RUNNER_HOLD.py and RUNNER_HOLD_REPRO.json: no real subprocesses; event order is launch(counts-only), admission(deferred:ascent_previous_size_not_recorded).
remediation: Separate nonnumeric eligibility from estimate-dependent admission. Respect ascent and applicable existing named/conditional/recorded-run holds before binding; after an eligible prepass recompute all numeric predicates and the denominator from its real bound row. Preserve the existing tier no-op baseline. Add tests requiring zero model-specific prepasses for held rows; do not fabricate numeric counts to query nonnumeric eligibility.
status: Open on exact908. ROOT confirmed finding and separately commissioned I24 shared-runner repair; that later candidate is outside this review.
